disc.alpha_rule: alpha = clip((outer_radius - distance) / (outer_radius - solid_radius), 0, 1) * 255 inside outer_radius, else 0

purpose: Analytic alpha fixture for MG-040. Every expectation is computed from this geometry, never eyeballed: a feathered disc whose alpha ramps linearly from 255 to 0 across an 8 px edge, a constant half-alpha rectangle, and a one-pixel chromatic checker that exposes chroma-subsampling and quantization drift. The MG-040 suite (runtime/tests/run-export-profiles.ts) generates the PNG frames from this spec with ffmpeg geq expressions built from the same numbers.
